cohort: The study included 113 mothers undergoing cesarean section under spinal anesthesia at Debre Tabor Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Ethiopia.
finding: The incidence of post-spinal anesthesia shivering was 34.5%, and it was significantly associated with not administering intrathecal pethidine, blood loss of 500-1000 ml, co-loading with less than 500 ml, and intraoperative maternal hypothermia.
cross-section timing: During and immediately after cesarean section under spinal anesthesia
